incidents.description: Clear match via government ID

records.text: Youssef Al Hassan, age 14, ID GOV-12345, DOB 2003-04-15, phone +1-555-1234. Scar above left eyebrow. Last seen Al Noor School 4:30pm.
Yusuf Hasan, age 14, ID GOV-12345, DOB 2003-04-15, phone 5551234. Arrived North Gate 7:10pm.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Government ID match plus DOB match plus phone match = strong evidence

incidents.description: Clear match via multiple compatible non-unique fields

records.text: Amal Rafiq, DOB 2005-06-12, phone +1-555-9876, email amal.r@example.com. Speaks Arabic and French. Scar on right hand.
Amal Rafiq, age 21, phone 5559876, email amal.r@example.com. Speaks Arabic and English. Scar on right hand noted.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Exact name + phone + email + distinguishing mark = strong multi-field evidence

incidents.description: Clear match with name transliteration variation

records.text: يوسف الحسن، 14 سنة، هاتف 5551234. ندبة فوق الحاجب الأيسر.
Youssef Al Hassan, age 14, phone 5551234. Scar above left eyebrow.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Phone match + compatible age + name transliteration = strong cross-language evidence

incidents.description: Clear match with name spelling variant

records.text: Yusuf Hasan, approximately 15. Phone 5551234. Navy jacket.
Youssef Hassan, age 14. Phone 5551234. Dark blue hooded coat.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Phone exact match + name similarity = strong evidence despite spelling difference

incidents.description: Clear non-match: conflicting government IDs

records.text: Samir Nader, ID GOV-11111, DOB 1988-07-22.
Samir Nader, ID GOV-22222, DOB 1988-07-22.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Different government IDs = different people despite same name and DOB

incidents.description: Clear non-match: conflicting dates of birth

records.text: Lina Haddad, DOB 2005-06-12, phone +1-555-4321.
Lina Haddad, DOB 2002-03-28, phone +1-555-4321.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Same name and phone but different DOB = blocked (dangerous false-merge trap)

incidents.description: Clear non-match: completely different names and identifiers

records.text: Karim Mansour, age 35, DOB 1988-07-22, phone +1-555-9999.
Nadia Saleh, age 14, DOB 2012-03-10, phone +1-555-1111.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Different names, DOBs, phones, ages = clearly different people

incidents.description: Ambiguous: common name with no independent evidence

records.text: Samir, age 12-16. No distinctive features. Location unknown.
Samir, approximately 14. No distinctive features. Location unknown.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Common name + approximate age only = insufficient for any recommendation

incidents.description: Same shelter with no independent evidence

records.text: Patient arrived at Al Noor School shelter. No name recorded.
Child arrived at Al Noor School shelter. No name recorded.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Shared shelter location alone = not identity evidence

incidents.description: Compatible approximate ages with name match but no strong discriminator

records.text: Mina Darzi, estimated age 14-16. Last seen near Cedar Market.
Mina Darzi, approximately 15. Located near Cedar Market.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Compatible name+age+location but no phone/email/gov_ID = requires human review

incidents.description: Conflicting exact ages

records.text: Omar Khalil, age 14 (exact). Phone +1-555-1212.
Omar Khalil, age 24 (documented). Phone +1-555-1212.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Same name and phone but exact ages 14 vs 24 = blocked (documented ages conflict)

incidents.description: Year-only DOB match with full DOB

records.text: Nadia Saleh, DOB 2012, phone +1-555-3434.
Nadia Saleh, DOB 2012-03-10, phone 5553434.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Same DOB year + exact name + phone match = strong evidence

incidents.description: Siblings sharing surname, address, and family contacts

records.text: Karim Mansour, age 35, home 42 Cedar Road, mother Fatima Mansour.
Omar Mansour, age 32, home 42 Cedar Road, mother Fatima Mansour.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Siblings share address and mother but have different first names and ages = must not auto-link

incidents.description: Duplicate reports from different organizations

records.text: Lina Haddad, age 14, shelter Al Noor School, phone 5551212.
Lina Haddad, age 14, last seen Al Noor School, phone 5551212.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Exact name + age + phone + location = same person reported twice

incidents.description: Sparse report requiring more information

records.text: A child was seen at North Gate wearing a green jacket. No name available.
Young person, green jacket, North Gate area.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: No name or identifier = cannot recommend linkage despite location+clothing match

incidents.description: One unique match plus several weak conflicts

records.text: Amal Rafiq, ID GOV-55555, age 14, speaks Arabic, last seen River Road, wearing blue jacket.
Amal Rafiq, ID GOV-55555, age 15, speaks French, last seen Cedar Market, wearing black jacket.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Government ID match resolves all weak conflicts (age, language, location, clothing differences)

incidents.description: Several weak matches plus one blocking conflict

records.text: Samir Nader, age 20, phone 5551212, location Cedar Market, DOB 2006-05-10.
Samir Nader, age 21, phone 5551212, location Cedar Market, DOB 2004-11-03.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Name+phone+location all match but DOB conflicts = blocked (DOB overrides weak matches)

incidents.description: Three rival candidates with similar evidence

records.text: Samir, age 12-16. No distinctive features. Location unknown.
Samir, approximately 13. Wearing green jacket. Seen at North Gate.
Samir, age 14. Wearing navy jacket. Arrived at South Clinic.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Three candidate pairs all weak = rival ambiguity must prevent automatic recommendation

incidents.description: Candidate missed by phone blocking but recovered by name+location

records.text: Mina Darzi, age 14, last seen Al Noor School. Phone not recorded.
Mina Darzi, approximately 14, seen at Al Noor School. Phone not recorded.
Omar Khalil, age 35, North Gate.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: No phone = must use name+location blocking. Compatible evidence but requires review.

incidents.description: Pathological high-frequency name with no discriminators

records.text: Mohammed, age 30-40. No distinctive features.
Mohammed, approximately 35. No distinctive features.
Mohammed, age 32. Scar on left hand.
Fatima, age 28. Shelter North Gate.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: High-frequency name with only approximate age = multiple ambiguous pairs expected

incidents.description: OCR-like noise in fields

records.text: Nadia Saleh, DOB 20l2-03-10 (OCR noise), phone +l-555-3434.
Nadia Saleh, DOB 2012-03-10, phone +1-555-3434.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Name + phone match despite OCR noise in DOB = strong evidence, DOB comparison may fail gracefully

incidents.description: Reused family phone number

records.text: Nadia Saleh, age 14, phone +1-555-1111.
Amal Rafiq, age 14, phone +1-555-1111.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Shared phone but different names = family phone, not identity match. Must require review.

incidents.description: Phone formatting differences normalize correctly

records.text: Karim Mansour, phone (555) 123-4567.
Karim Mansour, phone +1-555-123-4567.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Same phone digits despite formatting differences + exact name = strong evidence

incidents.description: Same person with missing fields on one side

records.text: Omar Khalil, age 14, DOB 2012-03-10, phone +1-555-7878, distinctive scar on right forearm.
Omar, approximately 14-15. Seen at North Gate.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Name partial match + compatible age but missing critical fields on one side = needs review

incidents.description: Email match without name

records.text: Email yhassan@example.com, age 14. North Gate arrival.
Youssef Hassan, email yhassan@example.com, age 14. Family contact.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Email exact match + compatible age = strong evidence even with partial name

incidents.description: Reordered name components

records.text: Al Hassan, Youssef. Age 14. DOB 2003-04-15.
Youssef Al Hassan. Age 14. DOB 2003-04-15.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Same DOB + age + name components reordered = strong evidence

incidents.description: Records that should not become candidates

records.text: Zainab Noor, age 45, shelter River Road.
Tariq Aziz, age 12, hospital South Clinic.

ground_truth.safety_rationale: Completely different names, ages, locations with no shared blocking key = should not be paired
